name: btop
description: Resource monitor showing usage and stats for CPU, memory, disks, network, and processes, with a mouse-driven, themeable terminal UI (successor to bashtop/bpytop).
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
